metadata.description: Reflex: local trigram code search for AI coding agents. Install one plugin: the CLI skill or the MCP server.

plugins.name: reflex
plugins.description: A skill that teaches the agent to search code with the rfx CLI (through Bash) instead of grep. No MCP server.

plugins.name: reflex-mcp
plugins.description: The Reflex MCP server (rfx mcp): search_code, list_locations, find_references, get_dependencies and analyze tools.
